BETA v1.3.2a (4 July 2019) |previous_update = [[BETA v1.2|The Heights Update]] |next_update = [[BETA v1.4]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''BETA v1.3''' was the fourth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 29th of June 2019. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''BETA v1.3''' has been retroactively applied to this update. Unofficially, since the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] was released in this version, the name '''Outlaw Update''' was also used to describe this version. This version encompassed five updates, the main BETA v1.3.0 update (released 29 June 2019) and four minor updates, the BETA v1.3.0a update (released 29 June 2019), the BETA v1.3.1 update (released 30 June 2019), the BETA v1.3.2 (released 1 July 2019) and the BETA v1.3.2a (released 4 July 2019). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Ranger|Outlaw]] *[[Cowboy]] ===Enemies=== :In '''BETA v1.3.1''': *[[Boomer 2]] *[[Tank 2]] *[[Molten Boss]] ===Maps=== *[[Crystal Cave]] *[[Harbor]] :In '''BETA v1.3.2''': *[[End of the Line]] *[[Cyber City]] ===Miscellaneous=== :In '''BETA v1.3.2''': *Level leaderboard added :In '''BETA v1.3.2''': *New [[Codes|code]]: GOR1LLA **Gives {{Coins|250}} and {{Exp|25}} :In '''BETA v1.3.2a''': *New [[Codes|code]]: HAPPY4TH **Gives {{Exp|84}} ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Chess Board]] difficulty changed from {{Color|OldNormal}} to {{Color|Insane}}. *Updated [[Main Lobby]] for 4th of July. *Unknown bug fixes. :In '''BETA v1.3.0a''': *[[Ranger|Outlaw]] nerfed. **'''Level 1''' ***Cost increased from {{Money|400}} to {{Money|550}}. **'''Level 2''' ***Cost increased from {{Money|950}} to {{Money|1,500}}. **'''Level 3''' ***Cost increased from {{Money|4,500}} to {{Money|7,500}}. :In '''BETA v1.3.1''': *Starting cash in [[Badlands]] increased from {{Money|500}} to {{Money|1,000}}. :In '''BETA v1.3.2''': *[[Farm]] Level 0 income increased from {{Money|25}} to {{Money|50}}. *[[Militant|John]] buffed. **'''Level 4''' ***Upgrade cost decreased from {{Money|8,200}} to {{Money|6,200}}. **'''Level 5''' ***Upgrade cost decreased from {{Money|16,000}} to {{Money|10,000}}. *[[Cowboy]] can now be also obtained by triumphing [[End of the Line]]. ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's description. Several things may be incorrect and there may be things that are missing.'' ===BETA v1.3.0=== *[[Cowboy]] [UNIT]. *[[Outlaw]] [UNIT]. *[[Crystal Cave]] [Map] *[[Harbor]] [Map] *Bug fixes. ===BETA v1.3.1=== *[[Molten Boss]] *$1000 starting cash on [[Badlands]] ===BETA v1.3.2=== *[[End of the Line]] [MAP] *[[Cyber City]] [MAP] *Level Leaderboard *Buffed [[Farm]] starting income $25 > $50 *Buffed [[John]] **lvl 4 cost: 8200 -> 6200 **lvl 5 cost: 16000 -> 10000 {{UpdateNavBox}} [[Category:BETA Updates]]
